overview: Student reporters for the Mustang Report interview Medford High School staff and students regarding high school athletics, physical education programs, and a reverse science fair.

items.title: Athletic Director Interview
items.summary: Athletic Director Robert Maloney discusses facility advantages, weather and budget challenges, and the hiring process for local coaches.

items.title: Boys Varsity Basketball Coach Interview
items.summary: New Boys Varsity Basketball Coach John Skerry shares his background, team philosophy, youth fall ball program, and tryout expectations.

items.title: Physical Education Teacher Interview
items.summary: Physical Education teacher Matthew Galusi details course scheduling, student health responsibilities, and physical education curriculum requirements.

items.title: Reverse Science Fair Coverage
items.summary: Reporters interview science fair participants and teacher Mr. Wilson about ongoing scientific research projects and practical lab applications.
